prompts.label: Caravelle
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original 2D ship profile icon for the ship-construction menu in a historical strategy game, not a production-method icon and not a 3D asset.
Style/medium: flat graphic cutout silhouette, very simplified readable shapes, restrained fine matte grain, gentle vertical light-to-dark color gradient. No bevels, no physical lighting, no 3D render, no photorealism. Dark thin unobtrusive contour only. Natural transparent openings between hull, sails and spars.
Composition/framing: one entire ship viewed exactly broadside, bow facing right, centered in a landscape canvas, clean generous transparent margin; clear readable silhouette even when only 30 pixels high. No perspective, no crew, no background, no sea, no waves, no cast shadow, no flags, no lettering, no border, no emblem, no watermark. Actual transparent alpha background, not a drawn checkerboard.
Primary request: a small early sailing caravel with a gently curved low wooden hull, slightly raised stern at the left, two masts carrying two large clearly triangular lateen sails. A short bowsprit at right. Use broad simple sail masses and only essential spars, omit miniature rigging and plank detail. Clearly unlike a multi-deck ship of the line.
Color palette: exclusively muted pale steel blue at the top transitioning into slate blue at the bottom, similar to historical strategy-game cruiser ship silhouettes (approximately #9bbcd0 to #536c9c). Hull and sails belong to the same monochrome blue family. No brown or white coloring.

generation.alpha_cleanup_prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Input image: the sole edit target, an existing monochrome ship UI icon.
Primary request: remove ALL external glow, haze and soft shadow around the ship. Replace ALL the empty space outside and between the ship's parts by absolutely empty true transparent alpha. This must be a clean hard-edged game icon cutout, not a luminous illustration. Only the vessel's physical silhouette, spars, sails, hull and oars may remain visible; absolutely no pixels of atmospheric glow around them. A one-pixel anti-aliased edge is fine. The ship itself is fully opaque, not ghostlike or translucent.
Preserve the original ship exactly: its broadside orientation, proportions, framing, mast and sail count, oars, internal drawing, monochrome palette and matte grain. Do not add or redesign any vessel parts. No background color, no checkerboard, no water, no shadow, no light rays, no text, no border. Output with genuine transparent background.

colour_revision.method: deterministic HSV colour correction only; no AI regeneration
